case.question: In 1814, 15 British individuals settled on T Island in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean, one of whom was a carrier of the recessive gene for retinitis pigmentosa. By 1960, among the 240 descendants living on this island, there were 4 patients and at least 9 carriers of the recessive gene, a proportion far higher than that in the ancestral British population. What factors caused the change in gene frequency in this population?
